ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) surface comprising roughly 80% of the visible area, with low-intensity (black) markings and trailing edge margins comprising the remaining 20%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large contiguous white regions forming the interior of each lobe; black pigmentation defines the entire trailing edge and median notch area; numerous discrete black linear and circular features are mapped across the white interior.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: A wide U-shaped depression at the center-line; the base is partially occluded by water, but the aperture angle is approximately 50-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the distal trailing edges with varying peak heights; highest frequency of serration observed on the outer upper quadrants of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a primarily concave curve from the tips toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Textured clusters of high-contrast pixels (barnacles) located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white marks present on the black trailing edge boundaries.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Densely packed, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) distributed across the ventral white surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: External barnacle colonization at both fluke tips; extensive rake mark scarring across the ventral surface; distinct circular lesions in the lower medial regions.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, large, high-contrast black spot located in the upper-left lateral region of the left lobe.
